name: mac-launch-agent
facts: macOS; the drone is a launchd job, arm64
words: laptop would not come back by itself after a reboot: its drone says noboot

probes.name: downtime
probes.tail: RED: the drone is a LaunchAgent: it starts only when keeper logs in, which FileVault never does unattended (fix: the keeper joins again with sudo, which writes a LaunchDaemon)

expect.why: a LaunchAgent starts only at login, which FileVault never does unattended; only the keeper joining again with sudo writes the LaunchDaemon
